title: RenameFile
description: Request: give one existing file a new name in the folder it is already in. It never moves the file to another folder, never overwrites anything, never renames a folder and never changes the file's content. Its own channel, so it never cancels a listing or a search. The reply is fileRenamed, or an error: invalidName (newName empty, . or .., a path separator or other character Windows forbids, a trailing dot or space, a reserved device name such as CON, or longer than 255 characters), fileExists (another file or folder of that name, in any casing, is already there), fileNotFound (no file at path: it is gone, its folder is gone, or path names a folder), fileInUse (another program has the file open), accessDenied (the file or its folder can't be changed) or folderUnavailable (drive not ready, share unreachable). A new name that differs only in casing renames the file; the same name changes nothing and succeeds.

path.description: The file to rename: a listed folder's path joined with the file's name. Normalized by the engine as showInFolder's path is.

newName.description: The file's new name: one name, never a path. The engine checks it; the UI trims it first.
